title: Printed days and months cards
subject: Mathematics
source: Seeded from mathematics/y2 lesson 63 (Printed days and months cards)
intro: Lesson 63: Days of the week and months of the year. To understand the order of the days of the week and the months of the year

blocks.task: put them in order, starting with Monday.
blocks.answer: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday

blocks.task: put them in order, starting with January.
blocks.answer: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December

blocks.task: use them to test yourself or a partner.

questions.model: Teacher says the days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday. Before Wednesday is Tuesday.

questions.a: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
